Karb-o-Bala Ke Dasht Mein Zainb Ki Hai Sada.
Nana Madina Choor Ke Aa Dekh Kya Howa.

1
Aal-e-Nabi Pe Sang Zani Shaam Ka Bazaar.
Umat Ne Kiasa Ajr-e-Risalat Adda Kiya.
Lakht-e-Jigar Ke Katte Howay Sir Ko Dekh Kar.
Zahra Baqiya Choor Ke Pohanchi Hai Karbala.

2
Afsoos Naak Baat Nahi Hai Tu Our Kya.
Mushkil Mein In Dino Hai Gharana Rasool Ka.
Aab Kiss Pe Qafila-e-Hussaini Kare Ga Naaz.
Abbas-e-Naamdar Nigehbaan Nahi Raha.

3
Barish Hoi Hai Khoon Ki Qatal-e-Hussain Per.
Yeh Zulm Aasman Se Dekha Nahi Giya.
Dunya Azai Lakh Kare Hum Pe Jor-o-Zulm.
Hum Dard-e-Dil Na Chorein Gay Matam Hussain Ka.

def sentence_case(line):
    words = line.removesuffix(\".\").split(\" \")
    return \" \".join(word if i == 0 or word.lower() in proper else word.lower() for i, word in enumerate(words))

۱
آلِ نبی پہ سنگ زنی شام کا بازار
امت نے کیسا اجرِ رسالت ادا کیا
لختِ جگر کے کٹے ہوئے سر کو دیکھ کر
زہرا بقیع چھوڑ کے پہنچی ہے کربلا

اب کس پہ قافلۂ حسینی کرے گا ناز

۳

assert [line.removesuffix(\".\").lower() for line in roman.splitlines()] == [line.lower() for line in roman_lines]

).replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]', 'tags: []')
roman_yaml = \"\\n\".join(\"  \" + line if line else \"\" for line in roman_lines)
path.write_text(f\"---{metadata}romanLyrics: |-\\n{roman_yaml}\\n---\\n\\n{source}\\n\")
subprocess.run([\"git\", \"diff\", \"--check\", \"--\", str(path)], check=True)

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and verified that they match the Roman transcription line for line across the preamble and three stanzas. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, updated the title and text direction, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read “Baqiya” as بقیع and the takhallus “Azai” as عزائی. Only the selected lyric was edited.
